state:
**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 2 (the build): the image component is built, packed and embedded; nothing loads it yet.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

`crates/nvs-ext/build.rs` compiles the packer into itself with `#[path]` (`pack`, `manifest`, `section`, `source`, `types`, and `src/common.rs`, which now holds `Malformed`, `malformed`, `kebab` and `is_identifier` for both crates). The `crates/nvs-builtin` fallback was not taken, so the Stage 2 checks keep naming `nvs-ext`. With the `engine` feature on, the script runs `cargo build --release --locked --target wasm32-wasip2` in `extensions/image` into `target/ext/`, with the parent's `RUSTFLAGS`, wrappers and target directory removed. It packs the wasm with `extensions/image/manifest.json` (only `info` for now, `Format` declared) and writes `OUT_DIR/image.nvsx` and `image.sha256`. `nvs_ext::builtin::IMAGE` and `IMAGE_SHA256` embed them (`crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs`).

Not yet checked: whether `Loader::load_bytes` accepts the packed component's imports and whether the manifest's `info` shape matches the export. `load_bytes` refuses any `Novis\` class through `reserved` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:560`), so the built-in set needs a path that skips that one check, and only that check.

items.text: **The built-in set and its pin** (`rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`) — a loader entry point that loads `IMAGE` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs:13`) before any `[[extension]]` entry, with every check of `crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:373` except `reserved` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:412`), and with `IMAGE_SHA256` as its pin. Compile on first use, not at load. If the manifest does not match the export, fix `extensions/image/manifest.json`.

**The Stage 2 Rust checks** — `crates/nvs-ext/tests/builtin.rs` (the four tests the record names; a `[[test]] name = "builtin"` with `required-features = ["engine"]` in `crates/nvs-ext/Cargo.toml:73`), and `two_builds_with_different_built_in_component_bytes_key_apart` against `crates/nvs-config/src/cache.rs:167`. `nvs-config` cannot depend on `nvs-ext` (the reverse edge exists), so `env_hash` takes the digest from its caller.

**The conformance case** — `tests/conformance/novis/image-info-answers-with-no-configuration.nvst`, once `nvs serve` and `nvs run` load the built-in set (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:119`, `loaded`).

backlog: libwebp: `bun nv webp-lib`, `tools/nv/test/webp-lib.test.ts`, the C-dependency ledger and the notice (goal file § Stage 2).
The manifest lists only `info`; every other export joins it as Stage 3 and 4 implement it (`extensions/image/manifest.json`).
The build script embeds nothing without the `engine` feature; a reader of manifests alone builds no component (`crates/nvs-ext/build.rs` module doc).
